Both deliverables are written to `coordination/goals/GOAL-ECQ-e72c0b/batches/BATCH-3d8863/tasks/TASK-20260903-941021/`:

- **protocol-v3.yaml** — closes R2a/R2b/R2c each with a named revision section and repair-diff note against protocol-v2:
  - **R2a** (closes J2R subfinding_3 / red-team TASK-20260831-b36a44): rewrites `proof_search_map.method_ceiling.nearby_object_control` in place — protocol-v2's supersession map *claimed* this location was fixed but the operative text never touched it, leaving an unscoped guarantee standing by contraposition. Now downgraded to match the other two locations' "design-time prediction pending a separate proof."
  - **R2b** (closes J3R sibling_null_half / red-team TASK-20260831-b36a44): replaces the degenerate `Q_i = -P_i` sibling null (numerically identical to the positive test, since Psi(-Pi)=Psi(Pi) and Pi is independent of B_i) with `Q_i := 2*P_j(i)`, using the halving/divisibility lemma (Psi is F2-valued, so Psi(2P)=0 always) to guarantee a provable non-ascent while still appending a genuinely distinct point.
  - **R2c** (closes J4R discriminant_figure_fidelity_check / validator TASK-20260831-e24039): hand-recounted the frozen discriminant string (two independent chunked passes, converging after catching a transcription slip) to 197 decimal digits, and restates one consistent figure set (10^196 order of magnitude, ~653–654 bits derived arithmetically from the digit count) replacing the inconsistent 204/664-bit/10^200 trio. Notes the qualitative infeasibility conclusion is unaffected.

- **task-report.yaml** — names all three revisions, model provenance (Claude Sonnet 5, effort dial absent/disclosed as before), and zero mathematical execution.

One deviation worth flagging: unlike every prior task in this chain, I had to run two Bash commands (`mkdir -p`, `ls`) to create this task's write-scope directory, which didn't exist yet. Both are disclosed explicitly in both deliverables — filesystem scaffolding only, no research computation, no timing probes. Every re-review CONCUR (J1R, J4R's other sub-findings, J2R subfindings 1–2, J3R positive half, proves_too_much object_1) is preserved verbatim by reference, `experiments_run: 0`, `mathematical_claims: []`, and no commit was made.
